name: Victory Circle Park
description: Neighborhood park on Victory Circle with benches for sitting outdoors and on-site parking. Hours: Mo-Su 06:00-23:00.

name: Sonic
description: Fast-food drive-in serving burgers and other quick meals. Hours: Mo-Th 06:00-22:30; Fr 06:00-24:00; Sa 07:00-24:00; Su 07:00-22:30.

name: Fort Smith Little Theatre
description: Volunteer-run community theater in downtown Fort Smith. See live stage plays, comedies, dramas, and musicals in a 200-seat auditorium.

name: Starbucks
description: Coffee shop serving brewed coffee and espresso drinks. Hours: Mo-Th 07:00-18:30, Fr 07:00-15:00.

name: KPot
description: All-you-can-eat Korean barbecue and hot pot restaurant. Diners can grill food or cook ingredients in broth at the table.

name: Kelley Park Ballfields
description: Outdoor ballfields used for youth baseball and softball in Fort Smith. Hours: Mo-Su 06:00-23:00.

name: Asian Bistro
description: Chinese takeout restaurant serving fried rice, lo mein, and other noodle dishes. Dine-in seating is limited.

name: Raising Cane's
description: Fast-food restaurant specializing in chicken fingers, served as meals and sandwiches. Hours: Su-Th 10:00-23:00; Fr-Sa 10:00-24:00.

name: Atlas Uniforms
description: Workwear and uniform store selling public-service apparel for police, firefighters, and EMS staff. Offers custom embroidery.

name: TGI Fridays
description: Casual American sit-down restaurant and bar serving burgers and classic bar food. Hours: Su 10:30-23:00; Mo-We 10:45-23:00; Th-Sa 10:45-24:00.

name: Bowling World
description: Indoor entertainment center with 72 bowling lanes, glow bowling, billiards, arcade games, and a snack shop.

name: La Nueva Micho Cana
description: Mexican ice cream shop serving fruit paletas and mangonadas with mango and chamoy.

name: The Arcade
description: Indoor retro arcade with classic video games and pinball machines.

name: Bookish
description: Independent bookstore in downtown Fort Smith for browsing and shopping for books. Hours: Tu-Fr 10:00-18:00; Sa 10:00-16:00.

name: Sharp Gaming
description: Hobby and game shop selling trading cards, collectibles, and tabletop gaming supplies. The gaming lounge has tables for playing in person.

name: Western Sizzlin'
description: American steakhouse serving steak and other classic American meals.

name: Freddy's
description: Fast-food restaurant serving steakburgers and frozen custard desserts.

name: South 28th Boutique
description: Clothing boutique selling business apparel and casual graphic tops.

name: Jerry Neel's Bar-B-Que & Catering
description: Barbecue restaurant and caterer serving ribs, barbecue sandwiches, and catfish.

name: Miss Laura's Brothel Museum
description: Historic house museum in a former brothel. Guided tours explore the lives of women who worked there and the history of sex work in Fort Smith.
